'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 John Veasey LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World]]
* '''Username:''' veez
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
